description.en: The ID of the NAT gateway.

description.zh:
NAT网关所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~448570~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the NAT gateway.

Call the [DescribeRegions](~~448570~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

title.zh: 查看单个NAT网关实例详细信息

descriptions.zh: 本接口可以查询单个公网NAT网关或VPC NAT网关的信息，文中出现的“NAT网关”不做具体的区分。
descriptions.en: Queries a public NAT gateway or VPC NAT gateway. In this topic, NAT Gateway refers to either type.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc get-nat-gateway-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --nat-gateway-id ngw-bp1b0lic8uz4r6vf20000 --region cn-hangzhou
